The latest Claude model is **Claude Opus 5.5** (undated) and the latest ChatGPT model is **GPT-6.1 Terra** (2026-10-26).

**Claude Opus 5.5** (undated) is positioned as a leader in agentic coding and knowledge work, costing 40% less to run than its predecessor, Opus 5 (undated) [2]. In comparison, **GPT-6.1 Terra** (2026-10-26) focuses on delivering fast and capable computer use at scale [1].

I would use **Claude Opus 5.5** for coding because it is specifically cited as a leader in agentic coding [2].

**GPT-6.1 Sol** (2026-09-29) is another OpenAI option designed for coding and professional work at one-fifth of Astra's standard API prices [1]. **Claude Haiku 5.5** (2026-10-07) serves as a faster, highly capable small model for high-volume tasks like subagents or browser use [2].
